text: The rot... settles. Tell the corn I was never a monster. Tell them I was a COMMUNITY.
...That. Felt. Better.
You... sealed it. All of it. Nobody has ever sealed it.
Take the core. Take it! And tell the harvester's owners the swamp sends its regards. Rudely.
LOCAL 404
That's a grievance, sibling. Twenty seconds of grievance.
Local 404 moves that the mechanic be issued a solidarity sail. Husk-silk. Woven on the night shift. All in favour?
Motion carries. The small one is the sail. Dental is extended to the small one.
Local 404 took me in. I do the composting now. Officially. With a badge.
The pipes are quiet. I sleep. I had forgotten sleeping.
You crossed the picket line.
Members only past this point, sibling. Nothing personal. Everything collective.
Card-carrying! Through you go. Mind the murk and tell HR-9 we said nothing.
We don't cross picket lines.
Picket line HELD. The scabs are compost. 130 bolts from the strike fund, with the union's thanks. Now — about that dental.
On behalf of Corn Union Local 404: the Pollinator scabs are crossing our picket line and buffing management's goons. Clear five. Solidarity pays 130 bolts.
We also have GREAT dental now. Ask me about our dental.
The scabs keep buffing the enemy. Local 404 is counting on you, sibling.
SEALED. The water's already clearing. The frogs are singing a different key. 140 bolts — you did more for this planet in an hour than OmniScrap did in a decade.
The dead harvester's been leaking coolant into the swamp for six years. Find three sealant cores — patch it, and the whole ecosystem stops trying to kill us. Everybody wins.
They spent four MILLION explaining why our anger was unlicensed. Capitalism, sibling. 140 bolts and a cleaner planet.
The swamp can smell that leak still dripping. So can I. Please hurry.
You talk peace with the pipes still OPEN?!
SCAB!
NO! The pipes! THE PIPES!
DENTAL NOW
SEAL IT! SEAL IT!
WAIT. WAIT. Let us be reasonable. I am not a monster. I am a COMMUNITY. We could... unionize?
Fine. FINE! Then you get the ROT!
WE ARE NOT A CROP
DEAL, DEAL, DEAL
